missables.name: Positive Mental Attitude
missables.warning: The only missable trophy. Its first meditation spot — Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — exists only in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, and is gone once the chapter ends. Do it before you finish Chapter 1.

sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (keengamer.com)
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements (egamers.io)

stages.focus: Begin the story as either protagonist and play Chapter 1's missions in order. Two things matter here and nowhere else: keep cheats off for the entire run, and when Lucia is at Jason's house in the morning after Down to Earth, follow her onto the balcony and meditate. That single scene is the only missable step on the road to platinum.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — start clean, catch the missable

stages.focus: Play the campaign through its five chapters. Every chapter and named-mission trophy is automatic and unmissable, so enjoy the story — but take optional missions when they appear, because the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is... unlocks the bank-vault route used later, and start stranger chains as they surface. From Chapter 2 both Jason and Lucia are playable, which the remaining meditation spots require.
stages.title: Chapters 2 to 5 — finish the story
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.focus: Three grinds shrink dramatically if they ride along with normal play: scan every new vehicle model with WAiNK (100 for the trophy, 200 of 277 for the checklist), try each of the 9 activity types once, and take stunt jumps and fog-clearing detours as they appear instead of saving 250 stunts and a whole state's fog for the end.
stages.title: Habits for the road — scan, sample, stunt as you travel

stages.focus: After the credits, open the checklist (Touch Pad, Progress, Stats, 100% Completion) and work it down. Its thresholds are lenient — about 60% of everything — but robberies, underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all drone races and Bret's quests are required in full, alongside 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets and 100 WAiNK locations. The gold for the checklist itself, A Long Road, is the hardest trophy in the game and the real centre of the platinum.
stages.title: The 100% Completion checklist — the long middle

stages.focus: Finish all 8 stranger mission strands. Andy's chain is Lucia-only; Tyrone's and Bret's are Jason-only, so check the map with the right protagonist. After the story, every quest giver tied to a trophy returns, so nothing here can be locked out — it is pure cleanup.
stages.title: Strangers, freaks and Bret — close every strand

stages.focus: Everything left is a single scene or a short chain: the two partner-crime trophies, the quiet jewelry job, the tank and the airport jet, the bowling alley and the Ocean Beach cocktail, the money trophies and the app registrations. Several of these were still unconfirmed in launch-week guides, so lean on the per-trophy guides and their sources for the ones marked unconfirmed.
stages.title: Partner crime and one-off moments — the sweep

stages.focus: When the 54th other trophy lands, the platinum awards itself. Nothing to grind, nothing to prepare — just check the tracker shows 55 of 55.
stages.title: Platinum — Leonida Legend

summary: One playthrough is enough: there are no difficulty trophies, no online trophies and no mission replay, and free-roam continues after the credits. The run falls into three natural blocks — the story (about 60-80 hours), the 100% Completion checklist (about 100 hours) and a short cleanup (about 10 hours) — roughly 200 hours in all. Two habits carry the whole roadmap: save manually at the start and end of every chapter, and never use cheats, which disable trophies and saving. Estimates follow the published roadmaps named in the sources.
title: Road to the Leonida Legend — a platinum roadmap
